{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data and clean it
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
valid_ages = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute and print the number of converted customers
print(f'Number of converted customers: {len(converted_customers)}')

# Compute and print the number of converted customers with missing age
print(f'Number of converted customers with customer_age == -1: {len(converted_customers[converted_customers["customer_age"] == -1])}')

# Compute and print the number of valid ages
print(f'Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_ages)}')

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages['customer_age'].mean()
print(f'Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age}')"}
